title: cynoglossum trinervium
intro: Cynoglossum trinervium, commonly known as Forked Tongue, is a perennial plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is native to the Himalayas and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cynoglossum trinervium include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
